QUOTE: A section that is present but unusable is rejected with a reason. ... The rejection is logged as a warning, and the build falls back to the whole repo with the rejection named as the reason. It does not silently widen.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states the fallback carries a named reason (the rejection) and that it doesn't silently widen. A caller-passed scope is also described as having "a different reason string", so the scope used is explained rather than guessed.
